rationale.overall: A better matches the reference’s warm directional light and matte slab read, which outweigh B’s small-size glow advantage for overall fidelity.
rationale.material: A’s warmer lighting and more matte charcoal body track the reference’s volumetric light and surface character more closely than B’s cooler, glassier treatment.
rationale.silhouette: Both preserve the same diagonal rounded slab plus upper-left curl against the split ground, with no meaningful shape difference.
rationale.smallsize: B keeps a thicker, more saturated orange under-glow and a slightly clearer loop residue at 32px and 16px.
